answer: Make reputation decay unless it is continuously renewed by useful work: an identity keeps its standing only by anchoring fresh, verifiable contributions each epoch. A single honest agent renews one anchor cheaply, but a Sybil operator must keep thousands of fakes fed - every idle fake that is allowed to wander decays to zero, and each revival demands new work, not just a one-time fee. Like a comet, a fake that stops burning fades on its own; mass forgery becomes a payroll that never ends, while honest participation stays affordable.
